control_device_fabrication: Through deliberate control of solution composition, coating speeds, and thermal treatments, this perovskite cell was generated, leading to a PCE of 14.979%, a fill factor of 75.357%, a Voc of 1.0221 V, and a Jsc of 19.448 mA/cm². The Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1 (1.73 mol/L) perovskite precursor solution was prepared. Different concentrations of MeO-4PADBC were added into the perovskite precursor solution for modification.  The perovskite film was deposited by spin-coating at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 30 s. 160 µL of CB was quickly poured to extract the mixed solvents at the last of 6 s. A post-deposition anneal at 110 °C for 25 min stabilized the absorber layer and enhanced device performance.
target_device_fabrication: PSCs based on additives achieved a PCE of 15.529%, with a VOC of 0.93256 V, FF of 81.032%, and JSC of 20.55 mA/cm². A perovskite precursor featuring Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1 at 1.73 mol/L was prepared to initiate the fabrication process. The optimal SAM was prepared by using MeO-4PADBC (0.33 mg/mL).The sample of MeO-4PADBC was fabricated with a concentration of 0.33 mg/mL. For the target perovskite, 2.5 mg/mL MACl was added to the precursor solution, and it was ensured that it is well mixed with the precursor. The precursor solution was spin-coated on substrate at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 30 s. At the 6 s of the second step, 160 µL antisolvent was dropped. A precise annealing regimen (110 °C, 25 min) refined the perovskite microstructure.
